manifest.name: Daily Counter
manifest.description: Counts something toward a daily goal with a big progress ring, a +step button, undo and the last 7 days. Fits: water, pages read, push-ups, breaks, cups of tea, any daily count.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

done_text.desc: posted to the chat when the goal is reached

notes_for_juli: Pick a short title (1-2 words) and a plural unit that matches the thing being counted. goal = a realistic daily number for that thing (water 8 glasses, pages 20, push-ups 50 with step 10). step = how many one tap adds (1 unless the person counts in sets). Choose one icon that shows the thing (drop for water, book for pages, flame for workouts, timer for breaks). cheers = 3-4 short, friendly lines, no emoji. done_text = one short sentence for the moment the goal is reached.
